label: FINANCIAL FRAUD
voice_script: He was the face of crypto: a 30-year-old genius in a t-shirt, managing billions. Celebrities, politicians, and millions of regular investors trusted Sam Bankman-Fried with their money. They thought FTX was the safest place in finance. They were wrong. Behind the complex algorithms was a simple, ancient crime. SBF was secretly gambling with their deposits—billions of dollars. When the bets went bad and everyone wanted their money back... it was gone. This wasn't a 'mistake'. It was one of the biggest heists in history.

screens.text: The world called him a genius.
screens.clip_moment: SBF speaking confidently on a panel, looking relaxed and articulate.
Montage of news anchors discussing the FTX collapse with urgent on-screen graphics.
SBF on a video call testifying, looking dishevelled in a t-shirt.

screens.text: The jury took 4 hours to decide.
screens.subtitle: Guilty. On all counts.
Sentence: 25 years.
screens.clip_moment: SBF in a suit walking into the courthouse, surrounded by media.
